cells.gaps: No system exists yet: the eCRVS is proposed by a study validated on 25 March 2026, and its three-centre pilot (Moroni, Mutsamudu, Fomboni) has not started. The costed plan (COM-004) and the 2024 strategic plan (COM-022) are given no period; plan:current rests on COM-004 saying the country holds it in August 2026. The newest paper statements say 'largely' paper (COM-001, COM-021), not paper only; the only flat statement is from 2017 (COM-034). COM-016 (ANEC decree not adopted, March 2026) is the one no-change event against nine advancing.
cells.note: Studies, a mapping of centres, a costed plan and a financing round are preparation of a system for local offices, so the cell is above stage 1. Stage 3 needs births entered digitally in local offices past a pilot, and no office enters anything digitally.
